title: Fixed shards for browser tests and on-demand rebalancing

intentCoverage.report:
Verdict: Caught.

Story: SEED-381#fixed-shards-for-browser-tests-and-on-demand-rebalancing (plan 656). Revision: 8b33b170c47a8dbd3dbee9e49a98c1217ce9b4eb, in a detached scratch worktree since removed.

Promise checked: "Loading a group's configuration fails, before any test is selected, when a spec file matches the patterns of two shards, naming the file and the shards."

Fault: in scripts/test-share-matrix.mjs `selectShare`, the overlap refusal block was deleted; fixtures and assertions untouched.

Wrong behavior, observed independently: a scratch call of `selectShare` with shard 1 `e2e/a/**` and shard 2 `e2e/a/x.spec.ts` raised no error; the overlapping file went silently to shard 2.

Runs: `node --test Distribution/tests/support/browser-group-shards.test.mjs Distribution/tests/support/dashboard-declared-shards.test.mjs Distribution/tests/support/test-share-workflow.test.mjs` (Node 24.21.0). Baseline 30/30 pass. Faulted 26 pass, 4 fail ("Missing expected exception"):
1. browser-group-shards.test.mjs "overlapping E2E patterns fail every shard and the unsplit run before any test is selected, naming one spec and both shards" (real ci.yml with an injected overlap).
2. dashboard-declared-shards.test.mjs "a spec two shards match fails the configuration with a split, naming it and both shards".
3. dashboard-declared-shards.test.mjs "a spec two shards match fails the configuration without a split, naming it and both shards".
4. test-share-workflow.test.mjs "a caller job's overlapping patterns are refused by the one selection rule".
The "<group>'s CI shards match every one of its actual specs exactly once" tests still passed, as expected: the real ci.yml has no overlap for this fault to reach.

Restoration: edit reverted from an EXIT trap; clean tree at 8b33b170c; rerun 30/30 pass; scratch worktree removed.

Next proof action: none for this promise and fault.

Cost: test runtime baseline 455 ms, faulted 374 ms, restored 387 ms; invocation-to-report 42,954 ms measured; agent effort unavailable.

Wrap-up disposition: 8b33b170c47a8dbd3dbee9e49a98c1217ce9b4eb, Caught, no follow-up.
